description: This file implements Linux-specific path lookup and symlink resolution logic for secure path joining, including handling of openat2, symlink stacks, and partial path resolution within a root directory.

classes.name: symlinkStackEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the symlink resolution stack, tracking directory, remaining path, and unwalked link components.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the symlinkStackEntry.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the directory handle associated with the symlinkStackEntry.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the symlink stack is empty.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes all entries in the symlink stack.

methods.name: popPart
methods.description: Removes a path component from the top of the symlink stack, with validation.

methods.name: PopPart
methods.description: Removes a path component from the symlink stack, cleaning up empty entries.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new symlink entry to the stack with directory, remaining path, and link target.

methods.name: SwapLink
methods.description: Replaces the current symlink component with a new link target, updating the stack accordingly.

methods.name: PopTopSymlink
methods.description: Removes and returns the top symlink entry from the stack.
